products.title: Tyson vs. van Gogh Premium Beanie
products.body_html:
Two legends. Two kinds of genius.

Tyson vs. van Gogh brings the worlds of boxing and art into a classic fight-poster showdown; power versus vulnerability, instinct versus expression. Iconic symbols collide, drawing parallels between the raw intensity of Mike Tyson & the tortured brilliance of Vincent van Gogh.

It’s a tribute to resilience, creativity, & the thin line between chaos and greatness.

Made from 100% acrylic, this beanie delivers lightweight warmth, durability, & a clean everyday fit.

Details

  • 100% acrylic
  • Classic cuffed beanie fit
  • Warm, durable, & season-ready

products.title: Tyson vs. van Gogh Dad Hat
products.body_html: “Tyson vs. van Gogh” by PJ O'Rourke, is a captivating fusion of the boxing & art worlds. Through skillful symbolism, it brilliantly juxtaposes the lives of boxing legend Mike Tyson & artist Vincent van Gogh, using the canvas & ear as potent icons of their experiences. This classic-style boxing poster pays homage to the resilience & artistry of these two iconic figures, masterfully crafted by the artist's deep admiration for their unique stories. 80% acrylic/ 20% cotton

products.title: Snorton Salt Premium Beanies
products.body_html:
A winter essential with a suspicious amount of confidence.

Snorton Salt takes a familiar piece of city iconography & gives it a knowing smirk. Inspired by New York’s cold-weather rituals, this character shows up every winter—keeping things moving, clearing the way, & maybe enjoying the moment a little too much. Purely municipal, of course.

Built from 100% recycled polyester, the ribbed knit delivers warmth, structure, & everyday durability. Old plastic bottles get a second life here—pressed into service for long walks, late nights, & mornings that start sharper than expected. Sustainable, functional, & oddly energizing.

The featured mustard yellow color hits high-visibility territory—bold, alert, impossible to ignore. Also available in light grey, navy, & black for those who prefer to keep things a little more… discreet.

Clean lines. Cold streets. A little extra edge.

Details-

• Ribbed knit construction with a snug, classic fit

• Featured color: mustard yellow

• Also available in light grey, navy, black

• Made from 100% recycled polyester

• Warm, durable, & winter-ready

• Sustainability note: recycled bottles, recycled habits, handled responsibly

products.title: Snorton Salt Dad Hat
products.body_html:
At first glance, it’s innocent. A calm lavender dad hat, a raincoat, an umbrella, and a quiet moment. Look a little closer and Snorton Salt reveals itself as a masterclass in subtlety—a visual wink to indulgence, restraint, and the art of pretending everything’s perfectly normal.

 

This piece lives in the gray area between polite society and bad decisions made quietly. It’s satire at its most refined: nothing explicit, nothing shouted—just a gentle nod for those who catch it. Consider it seasoning, not the main course.

 

Soft, broken-in, and effortlessly wearable, the lavender wash keeps things light while the embroidered artwork carries the joke. If you know, you know. If you don’t… well, it just looks like a nice hat.

 

And yes—sometimes all it takes is a little bump in perspective.

products.title: Selfies@Tiffany’s Bucket Hat
products.body_html:
Designed for elegance that endures, the Selfies at Tiffany’s bucket hat is crafted from durable cotton twill canvas; a fabric known for its strength, breathability, & soft, broken-in feel over time. The matte black finish gives it a grounded, utilitarian edge, while the embroidered Midtown muse adds a quiet note of sophistication & irony.

Bucket hats are made for real life. The downward brim offers natural sun protection in bright weather, shields your face during light rain, & cuts wind without feeling heavy or restrictive. Cotton twill canvas breathes in the heat, insulates just enough in cooler conditions, & packs easily without losing its shape; making it an all-season essential.

Equal parts practical & poetic, this piece is built for movement, unpredictability, & style that doesn’t disappear when the weather-or the world, changes.

Timeless. Functional. Effortlessly composed.

Details-

• 100% cotton twill

• Structured yet breathable construction

• Embroidered PJ Signature graphic

• Comfortable fit for daily wear

• Ideal for city life, travel, & beach days

Built on a well-structured black beanie, this piece holds its shape with intention. The all-black acrylic knit keeps the focus on the artwork; clean, restrained, & unmistakably deliberate. It’s a nod to old-world refinement filtered through contemporary city grit, where luxury & irony comfortably coexist.

Crafted from 100% acrylic, the beanie delivers warmth, durability, & structure without losing its sharp silhouette.

  • Premium embroidered Selfies at Tiffany’s artwork

products.title: Selfies@Tiffany's Dad Hats
products.body_html:
A study in contrast. This crisp white dad hat pairs purity & polish with playful rebellion. The clean, wholesome white crown sets the stage for an embroidered portrait of a timeless Hollywood muse, captured in Midtown; delicate features, poised posture, & a selfie stick in hand, blending old-world elegance with modern vanity in one effortless gesture.

Around back, a small black signature patch seals it with a quiet flex; all hand-sewn excellence, front to back. The solid black hat is a classic New York look, also.

Crafted from an 80% acrylic / 20% wool blend, the hat holds its shape while staying lightweight & comfortable. Finished with a classic dad-hat fit & adjustable strap, it’s equal parts innocent & iconic: where refinement meets irony.

Extra excellence in every package.

products.title: New York Kicks Trucker Hat Orange
products.body_html:
Built for late nights, long roads, & city blocks that never sleep. The New York Kicks trucker hat blends classic truck-stop energy with downtown New York attitude; bright orange up front, blacked-out mesh in the back, & zero interest in playing it safe.

The graphic pulls straight from the streets: sneakers hanging off telephone wires, pigeons posted up like they own the block, & the constant grind of the city in motion. Somewhere in the middle of it all is a frustrated 16-wheel driver crawling through construction zones near Penn Station; horn tapped, patience gone, boxed in by cones, cabs, & concrete.

It’s a nod to hustle, territory, & getting where you’re going by any means; whether that’s a cross-country haul or a hard left off the FDR at 2 a.m.

Materials & Construction-

• Structured foam front panel with durable polyester face

• Breathable polyester mesh back panels

• Curved foam-reinforced visor with stitched detailing

• Adjustable plastic snapback closure

• High-density embroidered front patch

products.title: New York Kicks Premium Beanie
products.body_html:
This piece started underground.

New York Kicks is one of the longest-standing designs in the collection, created in 2013 on the L train platform at Union Square while selling prints in the subway. Built entirely by hand, the concept flips Knicks into Kicks; a deceptively difficult lettering challenge solved through hours of careful pencil work, ink, & patience.

Inspired by hanging sneakers on telephone wires & a childhood love of Chuck Taylors, the design captures a classic urban symbol; part farewell, part territory marker, part street mythology. Telephone poles, pigeons, & meticulously detailed sneakers come together as a tribute to old-school basketball culture & the early days of an artist finding his voice underground.

The beanie is made from 100% acrylic, offering lightweight warmth, durability, & a classic everyday fit.

Details-

• 100% acrylic

• Classic cuffed beanie fit

• Warm, durable, & season-ready

products.title: New York Kicks Dad Hat
products.body_html:
Spike Lee himself bought this hat-

New York Kicks is a tribute to the grind; where sneakers hit pavement, ideas get tested in public, & nothing is handed out for free. The embroidered graphic fuses streetwear & survival; a pair of worn-in kicks crossed like tools, built from miles walked, stairs climbed, & platforms paced while waiting for the next opportunity.

Set on a black dad-hat base, the design feels earned, not ornamental. Crafted from an 80% acrylic / 20% wool blend, the hat balances durability with comfort, made to hold up through long days, unpredictable weather, & nonstop movement. The classic dad-hat fit keeps it relaxed & familiar; like something you’ve owned for years, even on day one.

This is the hat worn while carrying art under your arm, moving through stations, setting up quick, packing up faster, & trusting your feet to take you where you need to go.

A symbol of momentum.

A badge of miles logged.

New York; measured in steps, not shortcuts.

products.title: New York Hemps Premium Beanies
products.body_html:
Long ago on the tracks of the 7 train, a legend took shape.

Mr. Hemps became a folk hero of Queens; known for his bright orange cap, his giant rollups, generous spirit, & ability to lift moods wherever he went. From Queensboro Plaza to Main Street, he showed up with kindness, good vibes, & a smile, becoming a familiar presence to commuters, night riders, & anyone who needed a little light in their day.

No one knew where he came from or what he wanted in return, because he never asked for anything. His story rolled on like the 7 train itself; steady, communal, & unforgettable.

This neon orange beanie, made from 100% acrylic, pays tribute to that spirit; bold, warm, & impossible to miss.

Details-

  • 100% acrylic
  • Classic cuffed beanie fit
  • Warm, durable, & season-ready
  • Neon orange for maximum visibility

products.title: New York Hemps Garment Dye Hat
products.body_html:
This design is a tongue-in-cheek mashup of classic baseball iconography & New York counterculture; reworked specifically for a garment-dyed cement grey ballcap. The washed, broken-in tone gives the piece a lived-with feel, grounding the humor in something timeless & worn-right.

The grinning slugger swaps tradition for attitude, leaning into mischief, nostalgia, & a not-so-subtle nod to alternative “greens.” Illustrated in a vintage cartoon style, the character feels like a relic from another era; equal parts throwback & wink; quietly poking at New York’s evolving cultural landscape.

The cement grey base softens the colors & sharpens the irony, letting the embroidery pop without shouting. It’s playful, self-aware, & unmistakably New York.

A fun side note; Cohen’s daughter bought three.

products.title: New York Fuckery Trucker Hat
products.body_html:
Built for chaos, patience tests, & the kind of grit you only earn behind a windshield. The New York Fuckery Trucker Hat pulls its energy straight from the city’s pressure points: where progress crawls, tempers flare, & everyone’s just trying to get through the day without losing it.

This is the hat you wear while a stranger hops out of a sedan to help guide your rig through Manhattan traffic, hand signals flying, horns blaring, both of you laughing at how absurd it’s gotten. Or while you’re stuck for 45 minutes under the North Tube of the Lincoln Tunnel, engine humming, clock ticking, realizing New York doesn’t care how good your plan was.

Bold up front, breathable in the back, & built to take heat—literal & mental. It’s a nod to the drivers, workers, artists, & lifers who keep moving even when the city decides otherwise.

No polish. No patience theater. Just New York Fuckery, worn straight.

Materials & Construction-

• Structured foam front panel with durable polyester face

• Breathable polyester mesh back panels

• Curved foam-reinforced visor with stitched detailing

• Adjustable plastic snapback closure

• High-density embroidered front patch

products.title: New York Fuckery Premium Beanies
products.body_html:
The beanie plays it bright & bold, but the message cuts clean. Dreams are chased. Chaos is dodged. The city keeps spinning. Sometimes you hit. Most times, you don’t. Either way, you’re still standing there, smiling, playing the game again tomorrow.

Made for actual winter, not wishful thinking—this ribbed knit beanie delivers warmth, structure, & durability without pretending luck has anything to do with it. 

Details-

products.title: New York Fuckery Premium Beanies
products.body_html:
New York Fuckery reimagines the New York Lottery as a piece of social commentary—because daily life here already feels like a gamble. The design nods to delayed trains, missed connections, & the infamous “take the L” moments that define the city’s rhythm. It’s not just about luck; it’s about navigating the beautiful chaos.

Sharp, sarcastic, & strangely affectionate, this piece captures the frustration & charm of New York in one bold statement.

Available in a Blackout Blue knit for a little visual noise, or a solid black option for those who prefer it stripped back & understated.

products.title: New York Fuckery Bucket Hat
products.body_html:
New York Fuckery is endearing because it’s honest. The delays, the losses, the small wins, the big systems looming overhead ; micro struggles reflecting macro dysfunction. The city pushes you, tests you, & occasionally tries to shut you up.

New York Fuckery stands as both a love letter & a raised middle finger, proof that creative resistance survives pressure, & that in this city, endurance is an art form.

Designed on the subway platforms while hustling art, PJ has a special place in his heart for this one. This design was created in part in the Union Square L train, Uptown 6 Union Square, & Uptown. & it now stands as a symbol of Freedom of Speech.

Details-

products.title: New York City Arteries Premium Beanies
products.body_html:
NYC Subway map/human heart; transforming boroughs into chambers & train lines into veins & arteries. The city’s infrastructure becomes its anatomy, illustrating how the subway functions as New York’s lifeblood; pumping people, ideas, labor, & dreams through every corner of the city.

This piece reflects PJ O’Rourke’s deep personal connection to the subway & the MTA, where years of movement, creation, & survival shaped both the artist & the work. What’s usually seen as a map becomes something intimate & vital; a heartbeat you can feel if you’ve ever lived below street level.

The beanie itself is built for daily wear & real winters. Made from 100% recycled polyester, the ribbed knit offers warmth, durability, & structure while giving discarded plastic bottles a second life; mirroring the city’s constant cycle of reuse & reinvention.

Worn in February at the 34th St-Penn Station stop, it feels exactly right; cold air rushing through tunnels, platforms buzzing with motion, & the city pushing forward no matter the temperature. Functional, symbolic, & deeply New York; this is infrastructure you wear.

Details-

  • Ribbed knit construction with a classic, snug fit
  • Features the New York City Arteries heart-map embroidery
  • Made from 100% recycled polyester
  • Warm, durable, & cold-weather ready
  • Sustainable materials with long-term wear in mind

products.title: New York City Arteries Premium Beanies
products.body_html:
Arteries reimagines the NYC Subway Map as a heart, celebrating PJ O’Rourke’s deep connection to the subway & the MTA’s impact on his life. Shifting NYC’s boroughs into a heart shape, the subway lines become intricate veins & arteries, highlighting the city’s lifeblood. This art piece underscores the subway’s crucial role in NYC’s vitality & invites viewers to appreciate its heartbeat.

This well-structured beanie is built with intention; thick, durable, & architectural. The Blackout Grey palette lets the embroidered artery patch speak quietly but powerfully; like a pulse beneath concrete. Black is a classic go to. Inspired by the subway system as the city’s circulatory system, the design maps NYC as a living organism; alive, layered, & relentless.

Crafted from 100% acrylic, the knit holds its shape while delivering warmth without bulk. The structure gives it a clean silhouette whether worn cuffed or low; making it a true everyday piece with backbone.

Details-

  • 100% acrylic
  • Blackout Grey & Black colorway
  • Premium embroidered NYC Arteries patch
  • Dimensions; 12.5” H x 16.5” W
  • Durable, warm, & built to last

products.title: New York City Arteries Garment Dye Hat
products.body_html:
The New York City Arteries ballcap is finished in a garment-dyed cement grey; giving each hat its own distinct character. Subtle variations in tone & texture mean no two are exactly alike; creating a lived-in, premium look that feels broken in from day one.

The embroidered design maps New York’s five boroughs as a single anatomical heart; with subway lines stitched as veins & arteries. From The Bronx down to Brooklyn, every route represents movement, pressure, & connection; all part of one living system.

The cement grey base keeps the look grounded & understated; letting the embroidery stand out without overpowering it. Washed, matte, & industrial in feel, it elevates the classic ballcap beyond standard black or flat grey.

Built for everyday wear, this cap softens over time while holding its shape; developing even more character with use. Every hat features unique garment-dye variation & ships with extra goodies included.

The Arteries Dad Hat turns the city’s lifelines into a quiet statement. The embroidered patch depicts a human head mapped with subway lines & branching arteries; where thought, movement, & survival intersect. It’s a reminder that cities breathe through people, & people move through cities like blood through veins.

Made from a durable 80% acrylic / 20% wool blend, this black dad hat has a structured yet relaxed feel that holds its shape without feeling stiff. The low-profile crown & curved brim give it an easy, lived-in fit; effortless, everyday, & built to last.

Subtle, symbolic, & unmistakably New York, this piece doesn’t shout. It circulates.

Details-

Call it high-stakes. Call it high spirits.

Either way, LA’s a party.

The graphic captures New York the way it’s actually built; layers of labor, transit, history, & survival holding everything upright. Streets on top. Systems below. Weight everywhere.

Made from 100% recycled polyester, this ribbed beanie is built for real winter wear; warm, durable, & structured enough to keep its shape through daily movement. Old plastic bottles get reborn into something useful; just like the city constantly rebuilding itself from what came before.

Clean, architectural, & quietly heavy; this isn’t a novelty. It’s a diagram.

products.title: Brooklyn Cassettes Cork Tradesman Hat
products.body_html:
The waterproof Brooklyn Cassettes cork hat is legendary. We will restock at some point this year.

Brooklyn Cassettes is an early PJ O’Rourke II design that has grown into a lasting fan favorite—part nostalgia, part neighborhood pride, all attitude. Created around 2012, the piece captures a moment when sound, sport, & identity were being re-recorded in real time as culture migrated across the river & reshaped Brooklyn’s streets.

At the center is a classic cassette tape; an object synonymous with rewinding, replaying, & remixing history; rendered with bold simplicity & wrapped in motion, as if pulled straight from a boombox on a blacktop. The arched, sword-style typography gives the design its backbone: sharp, confident, & unmistakably retro, nodding to 1980s New York music, street hoops, & self-made culture while remaining timeless in form.

Stripped to a stark black-&-white palette, the piece stays raw & direct; like a logo painted on a gym wall or wheat-pasted on a corner. More than a graphic, Brooklyn Cassettes is about migration & memory: how culture moves, how scenes evolve, & how Brooklyn absorbs influence & turns history into style. It stands as a love letter to analog sound, street rhythm, & the borough’s ability to remix the past into something its own.

products.title: Bronx Bombers Premium Beanie
products.body_html:
A triple entendre, fully realized.

Bronx Bombers brings together three New York power symbols in one vision: the Yankees, WWII bomber aircraft, & the fearless graffiti train writers of the 70s & 80s. Dreamed up in 2013 & completed in 2016, the design fuses sports legacy, military precision, & underground art culture into a single, vibrant statement.

It carries the confidence of Babe Ruth calling his shot in the 1932 World Series, the courage & accuracy of Tuskegee Airman Roscoe C. Brown taking down a jet fighter in 1945, & the bold, clean energy of early graffiti legends like ZEPHYR. Spray cans become bombs, subway platforms grow wings, & imagination takes flight.

The beanie itself is made from 100% acrylic, delivering lightweight warmth, durability, & a classic fit built for everyday wear.

products.title: Bronx Bombers Dad Hat
products.body_html:
The Bronx Bombers dad hat is a triple entendre rooted in New York mythology. The design fuses the power of a B-52 bomber jet, the raw energy of graffiti-covered subway trains, & a nod to all-time greatness on the ballfield; where legends are made & pressure defines legacy.

Rendered as detailed embroidery on a classic dad-hat silhouette, this piece stands on its own with no affiliation or endorsement; purely a product of PJ O’Rourke’s imagination & New York state of mind.

Available in crispy white, this is another PJ O’Rourke New York classic; layered, symbolic, & unapologetically original.

Crafted from an 80% acrylic / 20% wool blend, the hat holds its shape while staying lightweight & comfortable. Finished with a classic dad-hat fit & adjustable strap,

products.title: Apartments & Inflation Windbreaker
products.body_html:
Apartments & Inflation is a tongue-in-cheek parody of the New York City Department of Sanitation; because in this city, rising rent & rising prices feel like hazards you deal with daily. The familiar civic seal gets reworked into a wearable warning label, stamped right on your head for maximum visibility.

The ribbed knit delivers a classic, no-nonsense fit; structured, warm, & built for everyday wear. Available in bottle green, black, mustard yellow, & light grey, it covers the full New York spectrum; from workwear to winter uniform.

Made from 100% recycled polyester, this beanie literally gives trash a second life. Old plastic bottles, new purpose. Consider it sanitation with a sense of humor.

It’s sustainable, practical, & quietly sarcastic; just like surviving New York, heading over the Queensboro Bridge.

Details-

  • Available in bottle green, black, mustard yellow, & light grey
  • Made from 100% recycled polyester
  • Soft, durable, & cold-weather ready
  • Sustainability note; yes, it’s made from recycled bottles; because someone had to clean up the mess
